speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue. I also have Appearance of pale skin, Presence of multiple pinpoint, red, nonblanching spots on extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those pinpoint red spots are concerning for petechiae, so I need to check your blood counts immediately. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count with Differential. Do you have any history of liver disease, recent medication use, or a family history of bleeding disorders?
